verdict.rationale: Gitea's API docs explicitly state that no vendor page documents a hosted test instance: try.gitea.io no longer resolves and demo.gitea.com is undocumented as a demo. The built-in Swagger try-it runs against the live instance, so it offers no isolation. Standing up a separate self-hosted instance would be a user-side workaround, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
